text:
Nina: Heads up team 00 Aurora Health just went live via the AWS Marketplace ISV Private Offer on Redwood Dedicated in us-east-2. Live event at 09:15 UTC. :party-parrot:
Carlos: Nice!! Any immediate signals on cost or latency improvements vs their previous self-hosted inference?
Maya: Early numbers: 50% lower per-token infra cost due to quantization + batching; p95 latency for their claims-normalization calls is ~180ms under production load (steady at ~140 req/s).
Tobias: Deploy trace: 
```
[09:10:01] package build: redwood-gpt-7b-1.0
[09:11:22] provision dedicated-pool: dh-pool-aurora-01
[09:13:05] start canary (10%) -> health ok
[09:15:02] switch 100% -> dh-pool-aurora-01
[09:15:10] post-deploy checks: ok
```
InfraBot: deployment/aurora-health/marketplace-listing succeeded (duration 310s) :white_check_mark:
Lena: Great teamwork. Aurora product manager asked for a short case blurb they can share internally. Can we get a 3-sentence summary + one metric?
Maya: Draft: "Since migrating to Redwood Dedicated via the AWS Marketplace, Aurora reduced inference costs by ~50% and saw a 2-3x drop in tail latency for claims parsing workflows." Thoughts?
Carlos: Solid. Add "dedicated pools with KV prefix caching" for a technical callout.
Maya: Updated: "... reduced inference costs by ~50% and saw a 2-3x drop in tail latency for claims parsing workflows, enabled by dedicated pools with KV prefix caching."
Nina: Legal note: need written permission to publish customer name/quote. @ProductMarketing pls coordinate the permission request and include privacy-safe screenshots (no PHI).
ProductMarketing: On it. I'll send the quote request + customer-approved blurb template. Will also request a short on-camera testimonial.
Tobias: FYI we enabled cross-region fallback to us-west-2 and configured audit logs to their KMS. DR run scheduled next week.
Lena: Can we also get an internal one-pager (perf + config) to share with sales? If Maya/Carlos can drop it here Ib4ll slot it into the marketplace case tile.
Carlos: Putting the one-pager in this thread in 30m. Will include config snippet and perf graphs.
Maya: Config snippet used:
```
deployment:
  mode: dedicated
  pool: dh-pool-aurora-01
  model: redwood-gpt-7b-1.0
  batching:
    strategy: latency-aware
    max_batch_tokens: 4096
  kv_cache: prefix
  quantization: int8
```
Nina: Huge thanks to infra, solutions-eng, and partner success for the fast turnaround. Will post a short note to #all-hands after legal signs off. :clap:
ProductMarketing: Once we have permission, Ib4ll draft the public case study and coordinate with Marketplace ops for the feature highlight. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Lena: Awesome. Anyone wants to join the customer success call tomorrow 16:00 UTC, DM me. Otherwise: congrats team 8526
